title: 第八章 这人是谁？
content_zh:
“苏叔叔，我什么时候开始工作？”陈木的想法是早点开始工作，早点熟悉这个药材公司，自己也能多拿些免费的药材，不然自己买的话估计还要花一大笔钱，自己可以没有钱。

    不过苏本见到陈木这么说，还以为是陈木想要早点跟自己的女儿接触，毕竟自己的女儿在宁华高中也是第一校花，他不相信陈木不认识苏林依。当下笑道：“不着急，依依她现在情绪不太稳定，我先带你去住的地方

    说着苏本拿出早已准备好的银行卡，递给陈木，道：“这是给你的这个月的工资，里面有五万块钱，密码是六个1。”

    陈木一愣，这还什么都没干就有五万块钱！要知道他摆摊卖药，如果不是运气好，估计一个月一分钱没赚到，看来这工作还真是好，陈木决定接下去一定要好好干这份工作，五万块钱虽然买到的药材只能坚持让自己修为提高到练气二层，但即便这样陈木也已经很满意了。

    看着陈木的震惊表情，苏本微微一笑，道：“陈木，你会不会开车？”

    陈木想了想，自己在图书馆里面的书里，确实看到过开车的一些规则，对于他来说早就不成问题，不过陈木还是如实回答道：“应该会，还没开过。”

    苏本有些奇怪的看了眼陈木，应该会，那是会还是不会？苏本以为是陈木好面子，不好意思说自己不会，不过对他来说这个不是什么问题，因为女儿上学都是有着专人司机的，就算陈木现在不会，等以后在学习一下，也很简单。

    苏本当下也不多话，将自己的车子开了出来，带着陈木到了一个外观看起来十分大气磅礴的别墅旁边，今天苏本很开心，所以也就没有请自己的司机，而是亲自带着陈木来到女儿的别墅里。

    走进别墅，陈木并没有感觉到想象中的富丽堂皇，而是整体的感觉都很优雅肃静，不过就算是整座别墅都是用灵石建造，陈木也不会感觉惊讶，对于他这个曾经的渡劫期高手来说，这些东西并不能吸引陈木。

    但在陈木进入别墅的一瞬间，突然感觉到了一股浓厚的灵气波动，陈木不管苏本的惊讶，直接快速走到了别墅前，苏林依栽种的花草前。

    “银叶草！”陈木没想到，灵气这么淡薄的星球上，竟然长出了银叶草这种灵草，虽然在苍月大陆，这种灵草是最低等的，但在这个星球上却能让自己修为提升道练气第七层，也就是练气期圆满境界！
content_en:
"Uncle Su, when will I start working?" Chen Mu's idea is to start working early, get familiar with this medicinal material company early, and get more free medicinal materials. Otherwise, it will probably cost a lot of money to buy it by himself, so he can have no money.

But when Su Ben saw what Chen Mu said, he thought it was Chen Mu who wanted to get in touch with his daughter earlier. After all, his daughter was also the number one beauty in Ninghua High School. He didn't believe that Chen Mu didn't know Su Linyi.Then he smiled and said: "Don't worry, Yiyi is not emotionally stable right now. I'll take you to your place first."

As he spoke, Su Ben took out the bank card he had prepared, handed it to Chen Mu, and said: "This is your salary for this month. There is fifty thousand yuan in it, and the password is six 1's."

Chen Mu was stunned. He already had fifty thousand yuan without doing anything!You must know that he set up a stall to sell medicine. If it weren't for his luck, he probably wouldn't have made a penny a month. It seemed that this job was really good. Chen Mu decided to do this job well. Although the medicinal materials he bought for 50,000 yuan could only improve his cultivation to the second level of Qi training, Chen Mu was already very satisfied even with this.

Seeing Chen Mu's shocked expression, Su Ben smiled slightly and said, "Chen Mu, can you drive?"

Chen Mu thought for a while and found that he had indeed seen some rules for driving in the books in the library. It had long been no problem for him, but Chen Mu still answered truthfully: "I should know it, but I haven't driven it yet."

Su Ben looked at Chen Mu strangely, he should be able to do it, would that be possible or not?Su originally thought it was because Chen Mu was trying to save his face, but he was embarrassed to say that he didn't know how to do it. However, this was not a problem for him because his daughter always had a dedicated driver when going to school. Even if Chen Mu didn't know how to do it now, it would be easy to learn it later.

Su Ben didn't say much at the moment, drove his car out, and took Chen Mu to a villa that looked very majestic. Su Ben was very happy today, so he didn't hire his driver, but took Chen Mu to his daughter's villa in person.

When he walked into the villa, Chen Mu did not feel the grandeur he imagined. Instead, the overall feeling was very elegant and solemn. However, even if the entire villa was built with spiritual stones, Chen Mu would not be surprised. For him, a former master of the tribulation period, these things did not attract Chen Mu.

But the moment Chen Mu entered the villa, he suddenly felt a strong wave of spiritual energy. Regardless of Su Ben's surprise, Chen Mu quickly walked to the front of the villa and in front of the flowers and plants planted by Su Linyi.

“Silverleaf grass!"Chen Mu didn't expect that a spiritual grass like silver leaf grass would grow on a planet with such weak spiritual energy. Although this kind of spiritual grass is the lowest in Cangyue Continent, on this planet it can allow him to improve his cultivation to the seventh level of Qi training, which is the state of perfect Qi training!
